answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. Work waits on the garden until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sable of the next round. The design leans on commit-reveal schemes for front-running resistance.
